title: Art Bell's satellite transmission failure during the Area 51 call
place_text: Coast to Coast AM broadcast, Nevada

tellings.quote: and the entire transmitting system by satellite went down here. And we were notified we were off the air.

plain: During a famous 1997 broadcast of Coast to Coast AM, a late-night radio show about the unexplained, a caller claiming to be from Area 51, a secret US Air Force base in Nevada, came on, and the show's whole satellite transmission system went down, taking it off the air. The host of that show, Art Bell, says this himself in a recording played on the episode. If true, it suggests someone did not want the call heard.
